drafts.walkScript: Look at lines 22 and 23, where Mrs Otis speaks. On line 22, "I am afraid" is a polite way to start, not fear. Line 23 says "something has been spilt there", so she thinks it is a spill. On line 22, "quite unconscious" describes Mrs Otis, not what she takes the stain to be. It is Mrs Umney, not Mrs Otis, who names Lady Eleanore on line 29.
